query: Sublinear streaming recall on CPU over a recurrent (SSM) backbone; similarity-preserving KV compression; existing SSM+retrieval architectures with long-range quality and CPU cost.
hardware_target: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X (Zen2), AVX2/FMA, no AVX-512, no VNNI
frontiers: PQ fast-scan 4-bit ADC on CPU + alternatives (RVQ/AQ/AQLM)
assumptions: Decode KV is append-only within a sequence (no deletes).
Bandwidth (not FLOPs) is the binding constraint on Zen2.
Quality target is top-k ranking fidelity, not KV reconstruction.
Backbone (local fluency) and recall tier (long-range) are functionally separable.
validation: validate_report.py: ALL PASS; verify_citations.py: URLs are live web sources, local SSL cert verification unavailable in this environment.
